messages.content: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Maria?
Hi. This is Michael Thompson. I'm not Maria. Was hoping you could tell me what your office hours are during the week.
Our clinic is open Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday from 9 AM to 4 PM, Wednesday from 12 PM to 7 PM. And Friday from 9 AM to 12 PM. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thanks for that. Are you open on Saturdays at all?
We're not open on Saturdays. Our clinic is open Monday through Friday only. Me know if you have any other questions.
What about early morning, like before 8 AM or late evenings?
We do not have appointments before 9 AM on most days. The only late evening hours are on Wednesdays. When we are open until 7 PM.
